knimeNode.name: Optimization Loop End
knimeNode.shortDescription: Stops the optimization loop at the NFE budget or configured objective targets.

fullDescription.intro: Feeds survivors back to Optimization Loop Start and internally maintains a bounded FIFO archive from replaced DE parents for SHADE/L-SHADE. The run-wide NFE budget is a strict ceiling: the loop stops before another complete generation when that batch would not fit. Only the active population controls NFE and objective-target stopping. Connect Track Progress's summary output to retain one compact convergence row per run, population, and loop pass.

ports.inPort: Evaluated survivors for the next optimization pass.
Connect Elitism's rejected-or-replaced output for SHADE/L-SHADE. The loop merges these parents into its internal FIFO archive and limits it to the active population size.
Track Progress summary for the current loop pass. Leave disconnected when convergence history is not needed.
ports.outPort: NFE, best value and stop reason.
All connected progress summaries accumulated across the completed loop.
